agent_explanation: Shrunk scenario shows deterministic energy explosion at first body-body collision with controller disabled (work 0) and no walls. At step 8 energy is ~3125 J (below E0 3316 J) and bodies are separated; at step 9 they are touching (gap 0.047) after 42 substeps and total energy jumps to 14969 J (~4.5x), exceeding allowed 3652 J. Body 1 speed more than doubles from 22.8 to 64.3 m/s in one step, showing spurious kinetic gain. High restitution (0.9/1.0) with high closing speed causes impulse + positional correction to add energy instead of conserving/dissipating.
